payload.title: The severity of tenant_repository_unscoped_read repeats four of the five names of REPOSITORY_READ_METHODS inline, so count (a read) is graded high while find, findOne, findOneBy and findBy are graded medium, and a read method added to the set would silently default to high; no test pins severity.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:118-119 (the read set and the method set)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:349-352 (an inline list of four names decides medium, everything else high)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.test.ts:564-583 (observed fields are call tuples and rule@line only, no severity)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner of one list (the PR states the read-method list has one owner, CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 2).
payload.notes: manager.count(Subscription, ...) passes the read gate (it is in REPOSITORY_READ_METHODS) but its finding is high while the other reads are medium, and adding findAndCount or exists to the set changes the gate and not the severity expression, so a read of an unlisted method is graded high by default with no test failing. Close condition: Derive severity from the same set (reads medium, writes and deletes high) in one function, state the grade of count on purpose, and add a test asserting the severity per method. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
